resources.string: Allows REC to request shared microphone input while a game uses voice chat. Enable only if you want this recording assistance. No screen content, touch actions, accessibility events or overlays are used. Android and the game may still prevent audio capture. Not verified on MIUI 14.
Enable REC microphone assistance in Accessibility settings
Assistance connected. Sharing still depends on Android and the game.
Assistance disconnected. Normal microphone policy applies.
Android has silenced REC microphone input. Recorded voice is unavailable.
Active status and controls for zero-copy screen recording
Quick recording and overlay controls in notification shade
REC requires overlay permission to show the floating game pill controls.
